legal.title: Data Privacy and Processing Commitment – SME Registrations
legal.intro: This commitment governs the collection and processing of data submitted when opening an SME workspace on the ROBUST ENTERPRISE MANAGEMENT platform ('REM'). By validating registration, the SME representative acknowledges acting with authority and consents to the submitted information being used within the strict limits of the purpose below.
legal.s1: Data is processed exclusively for: (i) identification of the company and its main administrator, (ii) creation and security of the REM account, (iii) contractual management of the service relationship, and (iv) compliance with legal, regulatory and traceability obligations applicable to SMEs.
legal.s2: REM processes only the data necessary for account registration: company name, country of operation, representative identity, professional email address and secure authentication identifier (encrypted password).
legal.s3: REM applies appropriate technical and organisational measures to preserve the confidentiality, integrity and availability of data. Access to information is limited to authorised personnel subject to a strict confidentiality obligation.
legal.s4: Data is retained for the period strictly necessary for SME account management and legal retention obligations, then deleted, anonymised or archived in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.
legal.s5Title: 5. Rights of the SME and its representative
legal.s5: Subject to applicable law, any data subject may request access, rectification, restriction, objection or deletion of data concerning them. Requests must be submitted to the platform administrator through official channels.
legal.s6: By ticking the acceptance box on the registration form, the SME representative declares having read this commitment, accepts its terms, and certifies the accuracy of the information provided.
